name: Shockwave
description:
A wave of seismic force sweeps out from you. Roll Spirit vs Dexterity against each creature within short range. On each win, the creature takes 1d8 damage and is pushed 10 ft away from you. On each loss, the creature takes half damage and is not pushed.

Check a Condition. If the condition you checked was Guilty, +1d damage.

Describe the shock.
successes:
✨: On each win the creature is pushed an additional 5 ft.

🌞: Win or lose, each creature is knocked prone.
